nonBlockingIssues.description: Unused `onCleanup` import in ml-store.ts. Cleanup is handled by dispose() called from App.tsx.
setInputs() always sets exactly 2 inputs (x, y). When hand mode (14 inputs) becomes active, the method signature will need to change. Acceptable for current scope.
saveState() doesn't persist midiCCCount, which would be needed for midi-cc mode restoration. Persistence loading is not in scope for this feature.
Redundant clamping at both MLStore.setInputs() and WasmIML.setInput() layers. Harmless defense-in-depth — double-clamping [0,1] is idempotent.

Follow mode requires pointerdown before tracking movement — doesn't enable hover-to-control. VAL-JOY-002 says 'pointer anywhere on main canvas controls position'. May need refinement at layout milestone when follow mode is fully wired.
Redundant draw() call in onPointerUp — the reactive effect already watches isDragging and triggers redraw.
Canvas size attributes (width/height) are set as static JSX props and won't update reactively if props.size changes after mount.

Test 'flow field canvas is visible only in visual mode' only checks visual mode visibility, doesn't verify canvas is hidden in synth mode. Canvas is always in DOM but render loop stops in non-visual modes.
mlStore is a mutable variable (let) passed as prop to FlowField via non-null assertion. Works because Show gates on ready() signal, but the pattern is worth watching.
